plan.problem: Synchronized profiles show substantial loss/backward stage cost. Existing SSIM performs five separate separable Gaussian blurs.
plan.change: Batch the three prediction-dependent moments together and the two reference-only moments together, preserving the 11x11 kernel, zero padding, formula and reference gradient behavior. This is batching, not the fused-ssim kernel implementation.
plan.acceptance: First verify forward maps and prediction gradients against the original on nonuniform odd/even images, then microbenchmark synchronized forward+backward. Only proceed to full three-scene A/B if the component does not regress. Use profiler-off in both A/B variants.
plan.full_comparison_skipped: Initial SSIM microbenchmark is slower in both tested shapes. Run only four 1000-step ETH3D pipeline checks, not the planned 12-run quality/speed study.
plan.excluded_probe: Early component probe reorganized the baseline moment-operation ordering. Discard its timing from the final comparison; restored the original baseline method verbatim except the optional branch. No real-photo runs used that probe.

raw_runs.measurement: adapter training, evaluation and export; excludes SfM and input copy

timing_scope: Serial adapter training/evaluation/export for a bounded 1000-step pipeline regression. Excludes SfM, input copy and source build; OS and driver caches not flushed. Stage profiling and image tensor caching disabled in both variants.
quality_scope: Frozen shared-camera geometry per scene, every eighth photo excluded from training but used in SfM; all scores recomputed at long edge 512. One 1000-step pair per scene validates the real-photo pipeline; it is not a quality/speed acceptance study.

microbenchmark.scope: Actual Apple Metal/Burn forward + prediction backward + gradient mean reduction/readback; excludes input construction and the pre-run device sync. For each shape, serial A/B/B/A with five warmups and twenty measured repetitions per block, forty measured samples per variant. Not end-to-end reconstruction time.

excluded_probe.reason: Early component probe reorganized the baseline moment-operation ordering. Discard its timing from the final comparison; restored the original baseline method verbatim except the optional branch. No real-photo runs used that probe.

references.name: Faster-GS
references.relevance: Implementation-level optimizations and fused SSIM in evaluation motivate measuring local stages before changing kernels. Paper speedups are not local measurements.

references.name: fused-ssim
references.relevance: Official README lists fused statistics and Metal/MPS support. This PyTorch extension is not directly interchangeable with Brush Burn/Wgpu; no code has been copied or installed.

tests: batched maps/gradients on odd/even RGB patterns and flat images; reference input remains without gradient

browser.observations: 1000-step models remain coarse, with blurred pipes and cables, stretched edges and missing coverage; no consistent roaming improvement.

decision: Do not enable moment batching. Final corrected-baseline component medians regress 13.09% and 15.37%; only four short real-photo pipeline checks were run. Keep the optional patch and numeric tests, skip the planned 12-run adoption study. Future direct kernel fusion requires separate correctness and backward tests.
